records.reason: The record already carries capacity + ignoredBulk for the extradimensional space; the Disguise Magic aura and the 1-action switch between spaces are narrative/table handling with no sheet value.
Raw precious-material stock: its whole content is a Hardness/HP/BT table for objects made from it, which is crafting/GM object-damage territory, not an owner effect.
Raw precious-material stock priced per Bulk; only crafting input and object Hardness/HP, no owner-sheet effect.
Generic 'object made of peachwood' entry; content is object Hardness/HP/BT and craft prices, adjudicated on the object, not on the character.
Generic peachwood object entry; only object Hardness/HP/BT and craft price, no owner-sheet effect.
Its only mechanic reduces an UNDEAD TARGET's physical resistance by 4 and counts as duskwood for the target's weaknesses/resistances - entirely target-side, and no field expresses resistance bypass.
Same material text; the 2-point resistance reduction applies to the undead TARGET's defences, not to the wielder's sheet.
Level 0, 5 gp merfolk water-filled helm; the printed text is pure flavour and states no mechanical benefit at all.
Consumable ammunition: everything (line attack, resistance ignore, extra damage, crit-spec placement) resolves inside the single Strike it is activated for, with no standing change to the shooter.

Relic aspect activation; every printed outcome is a Will save and a penalty/degree-shift imposed on OTHER creatures, plus a Stealth degree-shift the GM applies per creature - no owner-side numeric field applies.
Mundane tool whose whole content is permission to look around an obstacle from behind cover; it grants no bonus and explicitly gives no line of effect.

Delivered as a weapon record: category martial, group bomb, range 20, poison damage - the strike code reads those. The persistent piercing damage and the difficult-terrain square land on the target and are left as item prose, matching the hyldarfs-fang precedent.
Item-set header record (no price, no usage). The mechanics live in the six named set items and in the separate gift records; the header itself confers nothing.

Text states 'The fiddle is a handheld virtuoso instrument', and a virtuoso instrument gives a +1 item bonus to Performance checks made with it (see musical-instrument-virtuoso-handheld). Nothing on the record delivers that bonus. The relic gifts are separate records and are not part of this fix.

situational.when: on Performance checks played on this fiddle

records.reason: Artifact whose activations select other willing creatures (nonlethal-attack permission, which the engine applies no penalty for) and cast Raise Dead on a corpse; no owner-side standing value, and the silver-feather economy is GM-run.

An invested graft that explicitly grants the owner a horn unarmed attack dealing 1d8 piercing in the brawling group. Nothing on the record produces that Strike, so the buyer's Strikes page shows no horn. Exactly the same case as whip-tail, which does ship grantedStrikes.
Livestock/pet; the record's own PFS note states it cannot be combat trained or contribute to combat in any way.
Its only benefit is winning initiative ties against adversaries - a tie-break ruling made at the table with no roll modifier, and no field expresses initiative tie priority.
1 cp toy; pure flavour, no mechanics printed.
Mundane climbing gear whose whole content is permission - anchoring a rope so a critical failure while Climbing doesn't drop you all the way; it grants no bonus to Athletics.
Cannonball ammunition; the extra 1d10 elemental damage and the persistent damage on a critically failed Reflex save are dealt to targets when fired and are gone.
Container record already carries capacity + ignoredBulk for the extradimensional passage; opening the tunnel creates a piece of terrain the GM runs, with no wearer-sheet value.

Its text is 'this sinister suit of jet-black +1 full plate ... Usage worn armor ... Base Armor Full Plate', but the record is itemType 'equipment' with no acBonus, dexCap, checkPenalty, speedPenalty or strength. A buyer can equip it and get no AC at all. The remaining prose (graveknight rebuild speed, the curse timing) is GM-side. Fields copied verbatim from the full-plate record in the same file.

Same defect: printed as '+1 resilient full plate' (DC 24) but stored as itemType 'equipment' with no armor statistics, so wearing it changes nothing. Armor fields taken from full-plate; the built-in potency/resilient runes stay prose, as with the other 130+ named magic weapons/armor in the corpus.
Printed as '+2 resilient full plate' (DC 28) but the record carries no acBonus/dexCap/checkPenalty/strength and is typed 'equipment', so it delivers no AC. Armor fields copied from full-plate.
Printed as '+2 greater resilient full plate' (DC 31) but stored with no armor statistics and itemType 'equipment'; equipping it gives the wearer nothing. Armor fields copied from full-plate.
Mundane 5 sp deck of cards; flavour and setting colour only, no mechanics printed.
Activation erects a 20x15 illusory-dressed stage - a magical structure placed in the scene; nothing about it modifies the owner's sheet.
Timekeeping utility (a clockwork dial with a 24-hour duration); measuring elapsed time is table bookkeeping with no character-sheet value.
A concealed compartment that holds one dose of poison and releases it with an Interact; storage/permission only, and noticing it is a Perception check the GM rolls against the wearer.

Cursed item whose entire content is a penalty the GM runs: it strips any poison resistance you have and exposes you to giant scorpion venom when you take piercing/slashing damage. There is no field for removing a resistance, and poison exposure is resolved as an affliction at the table.
Same curse with wolfsbane; loss-of-resistance and poison exposure on damage have no representable field and are GM-adjudicated.
Same curse with purple worm venom; no field expresses negating a resistance, and the exposure is an affliction the GM runs.
Same curse with hemlock; nothing here is expressible as a standing owner modifier.

Base weapon statistics (simple, knife group, 1d4 piercing, thrown 10) are already on the record. The only extra is 1d4 persistent poison to the TARGET on a critical hit; strikeDamage has no crit-only or persistent form, and the corpus already leaves this as prose (hyldarfs-fang carries that note explicitly).
A 30 gp bundle of mundane gear (bedroll, climbing kit, skis, snowshoes, spyglass, etc.); the contents are the individual items, and the kit itself grants no bonus.
Purchasing an NPC's obligation; the whole entry is downtime/social play the GM adjudicates, with no printed mechanical effect.
Downtime/social service bought from a secret society contact; the GM decides what it accomplishes, and nothing touches the sheet.
Same GM-adjudicated favour, priced by degree of effort; no printed mechanics.
Relic aspect activation: damage in a 15-foot cone against a basic Fortitude save and dazzled on a critical failure - all on the creatures caught in it, resolved and gone.

The rune lets you walk on the surface of liquids. No legal field represents water walking (there is no such flag anywhere in the corpus - senses/speeds/resistances cannot express it), so there is no applicable fix; it stays a movement permission the GM applies.
Armor rune whose activation folds the armor into a bangle and back; it removes rather than adds statistics and the text explicitly hands the edge case ('at the GM's discretion') to the GM.
Activation grows the wheel into a 30-foot gambling room with a self-refilling ale keg; a structure placed in the scene, no owner-sheet change.

Its only mechanic softens the kickback trait's Strength penalty from -2 to -1 while deployed. The engine does not model the kickback penalty at all, so encoding -1 would ADD a penalty that does not otherwise exist - an over-grant in the wrong direction.
Deploying it lets you use the Take Cover action for standard cover behind its shield; cover is a positional state the GM/table tracks, not a standing sheet modifier.
Duplicate AoN entry for the shielded tripod; same reasoning - it enables Take Cover at the table and states the standard-cover rules, nothing standing.
For 1 minute the aura deals 3d6 damage to a creature that TOUCHES or melee-Strikes you; the whole effect is damage to the attacker, and the drinker gains no resistance, bonus or defence to record.
1d4 retributive damage dealt to whoever touches you; target-side only, no owner-sheet value.
4d8 retributive damage to attackers; nothing about the drinker's own statistics changes.
1 point of retributive damage to a creature that touches you; purely target-side.
2d4 retributive damage to touchers and melee attackers; the drinker gains no modifier, resistance or sense.
Paper targets sold in packs of ten for practice and competitions; flavour/downtime prop with no printed mechanics.
Pet; the record's own PFS note says it cannot be combat trained or contribute to combat in any way.

Relic aspect activation that applies a Clad in Metal spell of a rank scaling with relic level for 1 minute; there is no fixed printed value to encode and the relic-level scaling plus metal choice is resolved when used.
Relic aspect activation that replays a turn and lets you pick which one happened - a pure table-procedure rewind with no numeric effect to store.
Activation guarantees which face a coin toss lands on; the outcome is a narrative/table result with no sheet value.

Weapon statistics (simple, spear group, 1d6 piercing, thrown 20) are already on the record. The activation instantly reduces doomed by 1 and refunds 1 Mythic Point - both one-shot state changes the sheet's condition and Mythic Point controls already handle; the +1 striking is left as prose exactly as on the other 130+ named magic weapons.
Container rune that makes non-magical food spoil ten times slower and explicitly does not extend alchemical durations; a rations-bookkeeping effect with no sheet value.
Turns an animal killed by the shot into preserved meat, saving the hunter smoking/curing time; a downtime/logistics convenience with no owner statistic.

Delivered as a weapon record: martial, group bomb, range 20, 1d4 bludgeoning - the strike code reads those. Knocking the target prone and pushing Tiny creatures 5 feet are target-side outcomes left as prose.
